LanguageData.Raven_HighArchon.label: (Raven) High Archon
LanguageData.Raven_HighArchon.description:
The Raven High Archon is the ultimate biological weapon bred by the Raven race, possessing astounding intelligence and strength. Clad in black feathers shimmering with dark-gold luster, they can not only understand complex tactical commands but also have an almost maddening obsession with gold.

Traits:
- Golden Spirit: Can continuously evolve and strengthen its attributes by absorbing gold.
- Absolute Will: Immune to most mind control and berserk states (retains self-defense instinct).
- Extremely Rare: Almost impossible to find in the wild.
